nodeTests.scope: Domain tests plus mocked RPC and wallet boundary tests.

sr02Repairs: Moved browser validation to an active Blacksmith Chromium runner after the initial environment blocked local navigation.
Added an identified RPC client header for Arc testnet requests.
Updated the Playwright wait helper to the current keyword-only argument API and added exact status diagnostics.
Aligned the browser harness with the shipped Export instruction action.
Normalized signed raw-transaction prefixes and checksum-formatted transaction targets in the ephemeral test wallet adapter.
Persisted screenshots, exported files and the machine-readable pass report under evidence/browser.

boundedFaucetExperiment.resolution: Use Circle's interactive faucet with an owner-controlled Arc testnet wallet. Do not bypass the human-verification boundary.

ownerTooling.deployment: scripts/deploy.sh uses a locally encrypted Arc Foundry keystore alias, verifies chain and expected owner address, reruns tests and requires an exact mainnet confirmation.
ownerTooling.runtimePinning: scripts/pin-deployment.mjs requires exact deployed runtime bytecode and leaves writes disabled.
ownerTooling.writeEnableGate: scripts/enable-reviewed-deployment.mjs rechecks the runtime and exact one-USDC contract cap before enabling writes.
ownerTooling.independentVerifier: scripts/sr03-verify-live.mjs reads no private key and verifies deployment creation bytecode, runtime, payment receipt, canonical block, duplicate state and the 0.10-USDC smoke ceiling.
